subject.title: fix: OpenAI-compatible provider compat and error-body surfacing

question: Should OpenAI-compatible requests disable the SDK's two implicit retries by default so OpenClaw's outer retry and failover policy is the sole retry owner?
rationale: This changes a shared provider default for existing users; source and upstream behavior support the change, but only a maintainer can confirm the intended product-wide retry contract and acceptable transient-failure behavior.

options.title: Use app-owned retries
options.body: Keep maxRetries at zero by default, retain explicit caller overrides, and verify the outer retry or failover path covers production OpenAI-compatible calls.

options.title: Preserve SDK retries
options.body: Leave the SDK default intact and narrow zero-retry behavior to call sites that demonstrably perform their own retries.

options.title: Split retry policy
options.body: Land the independent compatibility and error-reporting fixes now, then review the retry-default change separately with dedicated failure-path proof.

recommendation.title: Use app-owned retries
recommendation.body: Keep maxRetries at zero by default, retain explicit caller overrides, and verify the outer retry or failover path covers production OpenAI-compatible calls.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent OpenAI-provider history and current implementation make this the strongest available owner for the shared retry-contract decision.
